mails.thread: Req. for EMD Insurance Surety Bond - MPPGCL 30 MW : Reg.
mails.body:
Dear Team,

We intend to participate in the upcoming tender "EPC Contractor for Design, Engineering, Supply, Construction, Erection, Testing and Commissioning including civil works on turnkey basis of 30 MWac Ground Mounted Solar PV Power Projects at vacant lands at Sanjay Gandhi Thermal Power Plant (SGTPS), Birsinghpur in the state of Madhya Pradesh with Comprehensive Operation & Maintenance for five (5) years period from the Operational Acceptance Test (OAT) of Project."

In view of the above, an EMD of 1 Cr in the form of ISB to be submitted to MPPGCL, Please find the calculations below:

S. No. MPPGCL 30 MW Birsinghpur, MP Bid Security - ₹100 Lakhs
a Bid submission date 05-Oct-26
b Bid validity, days 270
c Bond condition, days 0
d +Additional, days 30
e Total Bond Validity in days 300
f Bond Validity Date 01-Aug-27
g Claim date 30-Oct-27

Please find the draft bond attached for your review and furtherance. MCOM approval is underway.
